passive.name: King's Tribute
passive.tooltip: When an enemy dies near Trundle, he restores <healing>@RegenPercent@ of its max Health</healing>.

spells.name: Chomp
spells.tooltip: Trundle's next Attack deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and briefly <status>Slows</status> by @SlowAmount*100@%, then Trundle gains <physicalDamage>@BonusAD@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for @SapDebuffDuration@ seconds and the enemy loses <physicalDamage>@SappedAD*-1@ Attack Damage</physicalDamage> for the same duration.
spells.tooltipExtended:
This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
Trundle gains @BonusRange@ attack range for this attack.

spells.name: Frozen Domain
spells.tooltip: Trundle freezes an area for @Duration@ seconds. While inside he gains <speed>@MSBonus*100@% Move Speed</speed>, <attackSpeed>@ASBonus*100@% Attack Speed</attackSpeed>, and @HealingBonus*100@% increased healing.

spells.name: Pillar of Ice
spells.tooltip: Trundle creates an icy pillar for @PillarDuration@ seconds, briefly <status>Knocking Back</status> enemies directly over it and <status>Slowing</status> nearby enemies by @SlowAmount@%.

spells.name: Subjugate
spells.tooltip: Trundle drains the lifeforce of an enemy champion, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalPercentHPDamage@ max Health magic damage</magicDamage> and stealing <scaleArmor>@ArmorMRShred*100@% Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> over @ActualDurationOfDrainBuff@ seconds.
spells.tooltipExtended:
Half of the damage and shred happen immediately and the other half happens over the duration.
The shred lasts for @DurationOfDrainForTooltip@ seconds after the drain ends.
